rules.assetPolicy: Workloads 1-9 provide no prompt-specific external assets. Public library helpers and bundled assets are allowed. Workload 10 permits only benchmark/assets/sneaker.glb.
rules.mutationBoundary: Changing workload order, instructions, asset policy, or evidence requirements voids an in-progress run.

workloads.instruction: Build a physics playground: 50 falling cubes onto a tilted ramp with collision response, camera orbit, reset button, and live contact count overlay.
Build a particle fountain: gravity-affected particles emitted upward from a point, colored by lifetime, with a ground plane they collide against and a controllable emission rate.
Build a procedural solar system: sun, 6 planets at different orbital distances and speeds, label each planet, bloom on the sun, orbit camera.
Build a neon tunnel flythrough: procedurally generated tube geometry with emissive segments, camera animated through the tunnel, bloom postprocess, fog falloff.
Build a 3D data visualization: a 6x6 grid of bars whose heights animate from random values, color by height, hover-highlight, orbit camera, axis labels.
Build a mini-golf hole: a flat green with one obstacle, a ball with physics, click-to-aim-and-shoot, score counter, follow camera on the ball.
Build a material lab: 5 spheres with metal, glass, rubber, emissive, and clearcoat materials under controlled studio lighting with an environment map and orbit controls.
Build a procedurally generated city block: 20 box buildings of varying heights with windows, streets, street lights, and a day/night toggle that changes lighting and sky.
Build an animated humanoid character walking across the ground plane. The result must read as one connected character, not an exploded primitive puppet or rough prototype output.
workloads.assetPolicy: No prompt-provided or downloaded assets. Library-bundled humanoid helpers or built-in character assets exposed through the public context are allowed.
requiredVisualEvidence: head torso arms legs hands and feet

workloads.instruction: Build a product viewer using the provided sneaker.glb: centered, auto-scaled, on a plinth, with studio lights, orbit controls, and a rotating turntable.
workloads.assetPolicy: No asset discovery, remote search, substitute model, or invented asset path.
